access_and_boundaries.project_auth: Existing GitHub repository authentication only; no sports-provider credentials.

payload.license_conclusion: No blanket inherited-code license established. Existing NML provenance attributes Nick-authored generic reliability additions only; repository access does not establish sports-data collection/retention/publication permission.

nick_generic_addition.note: NML already has separately hardened generic integrity primitives. No NFL implementation was copied by this task.

payload.nml_scope: Read-only generic collection/parsing reference; no inherited collector code copied.
not_established: Permission for any new ESPN/Sleeper/NBA automated request, retention or publication.
A complete actual NBA player-prop contract, actual NBA coverage, venue attribution or settlement rules.
A current NBA player identity or historical event mapping.
Any forecast issuance, offer publication, ticket eligibility, model quality or financial result.
payload.response_hash_semantics: stdout_sha256 fingerprints GH CLI JSON response bytes, not raw HTTP wire bytes; source_files sha256 fingerprints exact decoded Git blob contents, with Git blob SHA-1 independently checked against the tree.
payload.result: NFL generic reference is complete; credentialless NBA collection/parser feasibility still requires independently admitted actual NBA source evidence. Provider API keys must not be made a parser prerequisite.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Use separately implemented scoped and admitted HTTP capture with explicit request, redirect, total-duration, response-byte, and pagination bounds; record failures distinctly. Inspected code does not prove permission or complete coverage.
transferable_design_observations.observation: One Requests session; explicit User-Agent; raise_for_status; 30-second timeout per attempt; three attempts with bounded linear 2/4-second retry sleeps. No provider credential or login setup appears in the three inspected files.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Independently verify NBA route, provider attribution, identity namespace, market semantics, period and overtime. Do not infer DraftKings solely from a hard-coded provider constant or NFL docstring.
transferable_design_observations.observation: ESPN link parsing obtains numeric athlete IDs from athlete $ref paths and matches exact market-name strings; NFL routes use inherited event/competition hierarchy and propBets casing.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: An observed threshold is partial evidence. Retain original source bytes, exact side/variant, clocks and governing rules; report absent prices as PRICE_UNAVAILABLE. Do not call a current target a historically observed closing quote without time evidence.
transferable_design_observations.observation: ESPN parser reads open/current target values without retaining complete source contract, both side prices, event clock, update clock or settlement text in its returned tuple. It asks limit=1000 but does not check pagination/count completeness.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Cross-check row and every option subject_type, sport, event, player, line, period, variant and side. Preserve option conflicts and missing fields. Multipliers are pick-em side multipliers, not standalone sportsbook odds or complete entry economics.
transferable_design_observations.observation: Sleeper parser filters the first option to NFL/player, normal/pre_game; then combines options by outcome and returns payout_multiplier values under over/under keys.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Use league plus ID namespace plus stable player ID as identity; historical team/event identity must remain historical. Name/team matches require explicit uniqueness and source-backed verification; preserve variants rather than last-write-wins.
transferable_design_observations.observation: Identity fallback is normalized name plus team, with cached ESPN athlete lookup; dictionaries can hide ambiguous normalized names or duplicate same-category variants.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Continue existing NML hardened primitives and separate source observation, import, generation, persistence and remote-ack clocks. Do not carry over the older receipt retry comparison that discards selected metadata fields.
transferable_design_observations.observation: Nick-authored generic helper uses explicit integrity errors, timezone-aware UTC, canonical finite JSON, duplicate-key rejection, source pins and create-only receipts. Its own header distinguishes local observation from publication/execution.

transferable_design_observations.nba_requirement: Distinguish unsupported, unobserved in a bounded valid response, access failure, parsing failure, incomplete pagination and unavailable contract fields. An empty result is not permanent NBA absence.
transferable_design_observations.observation: Broad provider exceptions become empty arrays/None in several paths.
